text: Hello, and welcome to Acquired, the podcast about great companies and the stories and playbooks behind them.
text_zh: 你好，欢迎收听 Acquired——一档讲述伟大公司、以及它们背后故事与方法论秘籍的播客。

text: I'm Ben Gilbert.
text_zh: 我是 Ben Gilbert。

text: I'm David Rosenthal.
text_zh: 我是 David Rosenthal。

text: And we are your hosts.
text_zh: 我们是这档节目的主播。

text: So, Ben and I are obsessed with uncovering the history, strategy, and stories behind what built the greatest companies in the world.
text_zh: 我和 Ben 痴迷于挖掘历史、战略和故事——那些成就了世界上最伟大公司的东西。

text: Each month, we choose a company, and we spend the entire month researching what uniquely made it work, where many others failed.
text_zh: 每个月，我们会选一家公司，花整整一个月研究：是什么让它脱颖而出，而其他许多公司却失败了。

text: The output of that is a full-day recording session where Ben and I come together and tell the absolute deepest business and technology stories on the internet.
text_zh: 最终的成果，是一场全天的录制——我和 Ben 坐在一起，讲述互联网上最深度的商业与科技故事。

text: And when we say obsessed, we mean that we spend 100 hours each reading everything that exists about a company,
text_zh: 说到痴迷，我们是认真的：每个人会花一百个小时，读完关于这家公司能找到的一切资料，

text: and doing primary research and background interviews with the people who lived it firsthand.
text_zh: 还会做一手调研，采访那些亲身经历过这段历史的人。

text: These are stories like NVIDIA, Costco, Hermes, Microsoft, Rolex, Amazon.
text_zh: 这些故事的主角包括 NVIDIA、Costco、爱马仕、微软、劳力士、亚马逊。

text: Those are some of our favorites, anyway.
text_zh: 至少这些是我们最喜欢的几期。

text: What started 10 years ago as just the study of tech companies has led to a curiosity about our broader world from Berkshire Hathaway to the NFL or even Taylor Swift.
text_zh: 十年前，我们只是研究科技公司；如今好奇心已经扩展到更广阔的世界——从伯克希尔·哈撒韦，到 NFL，甚至 Taylor Swift。

text: Our goal in creating each episode is to uncover the secrets that are lurking in plain sight
text_zh: 我们制作每一期节目的目标，是揭开那些藏在众目睽睽之下的秘密，

text: and how these world-changing companies went from obscurity to ubiquity.
text_zh: 以及这些改变世界的公司，如何从小透明变得无处不在。

text: So if you've ever wondered, how did Starbucks end up on every corner around the globe?
text_zh: 如果你曾经好奇：星巴克是怎么开遍全球每个角落的？

text: Or what does Visa actually do, and how did they become the payment rails of the whole globe?
text_zh: Visa 到底是做什么的，又如何成为了整个地球的支付基础设施？

text: Or why is the NFL so much bigger than other sports leagues?
text_zh: 为什么 NFL 比其他体育联盟大那么多？

text: Then Acquired is for you.
text_zh: 那么，Acquired 就是为你准备的。

text: Yep.
text_zh: 没错。

text: We have a unique format that we do on the show.
text_zh: 我们的节目有一种独特的形式，

text: We call it a conversational audiobook.
text_zh: 我们称之为「对话式有声书」。

text: Ben and I tell these stories of these companies through a deep conversation.
text_zh: 我和 Ben 通过一场深度对谈，来讲述这些公司的故事。

text: And typically, it's just the two of us without an interview guest.
text_zh: 通常只有我们两个人，没有访谈嘉宾。

text: Occasionally, we will bring in a protagonist from the story, like Howard Schultz from Starbucks,
text_zh: 偶尔，我们也会请来故事的主角——比如星巴克的 Howard Schultz，

text: or Jensen Huang from NVIDIA, or Mark Zuckerberg from Meta.
text_zh: NVIDIA 的黄仁勋，或者 Meta 的扎克伯格。

text: Usually, though, that's as a follow-up interview to a deep dive that we've already done on their company.
text_zh: 不过通常，那是在我们已经做完该公司深度节目之后的补充访谈。

text: Now, one thing we should say.
text_zh: 不过有一件事要先告诉你。

text: Our episodes are typically very long, like three to four hours long, since we go really deep.
text_zh: 我们的单集通常非常长，三到四个小时，因为我们挖得真的很深。

text: But don't be scared.
text_zh: 但别被吓到。

text: These are amazing stories that deserve every minute.
text_zh: 这些都是精彩绝伦的故事，每一分钟都值得。

text: And we have a lot of fun along the way.
text_zh: 而且整个过程我们自己也乐在其中。

text: Our goal is really to deliver a complete understanding of a company by the time you finish the episode.
text_zh: 我们的目标是：当你听完一期节目，就能真正完整地理解一家公司。

text: So we're glad you're here.
text_zh: 很高兴你来了。

text: Welcome.
text_zh: 欢迎。

text: And if you ever want to discuss any episodes or give us any feedback, join us in the Acquired community at Acquired.fm slash Slack.
text_zh: 如果你想讨论任何一期节目，或者给我们反馈，欢迎加入 Acquired 社区，访问 Acquired.fm/slack。

text: Welcome.
text_zh: 欢迎。

text: Welcome.
text_zh: 欢迎收听。
